rules.action: Never persist credentials, private keys, raw provider secrets, or machine-local paths in tracked source, generated reports, logs, or agent context packs.
When a public contract changes, update its schema, implementation, consumers, generated artifacts, and contract verification in the same change.
Keep schema, migration, adapter, restart persistence, rollback, and compatibility behavior synchronized for storage changes.
Keep plan binding, pre-tool policy, post-tool Guard, validation, second Guard, reporting, and failure knowledge synchronized and covered by tests.
